title: Strict henselization is faithfully flat
statement: Let $R$ be a local commutative ring with residue field $k$, let $K$ be a separable closure of $k$, and let $R^{\mathrm{sh}}$ be the strict henselization obtained as the filtered colimit of etale $R$-algebras equipped with a point over the closed point and a residue-field embedding into $K$ [lem-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-triples]. Then the canonical local ring map $R\to R^{\mathrm{sh}}$ is faithfully flat [def-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ring-map].

source.place: Lemma Tag 07QM (lemma-dumb-properties-henselization), part (1): R -> R^h -> R^sh are faithfully flat; R^sh as constructed in Algebra, Lemma Tag 04GP (lemma-strict-henselization)

proof.text: Let $\mathfrak m$ be the maximal ideal of the local ring $R$. Applying [lem-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-triples] to the pair $(R,\mathfrak m)$ identifies the filtered colimit in the statement with the ring $C=(R_{\mathfrak m})^{\mathrm{sh}}=R^{\mathrm{sh}}$, and its canonical map from $R$ with the structural map of that strict henselization. The residue-field embedding into $K$ is exactly the chosen embedding in the triple construction.

source.place: Lemma Tag 07QM (lemma-dumb-properties-henselization), part (1), using the strict henselization construction of Algebra Tag 04GP

proof.text: Every algebra in the filtered diagram is etale over $R$, hence flat over $R$ by [lem-weil-pbc-etale-algebra-flat]. The underlying $R$-module of the colimit $R^{\mathrm{sh}}$ is the filtered colimit of these flat modules, so [lem-weil-pbc-filtered-colimit-flat-modules] shows that $R^{\mathrm{sh}}$ is flat over $R$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 07QM (lemma-dumb-properties-henselization), proof of (1): the maps R -> R^h -> R^sh are flat

proof.text: The triple construction makes $R^{\mathrm{sh}}$ local and the structural map $R\to R^{\mathrm{sh}}$ local, since the preimage of its maximal ideal is the maximal ideal of $R$ [lem-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-triples]. A flat local homomorphism of local rings is faithfully flat by [lem-pc-local-flat-faithful-flat-reflects-surjective]. Therefore the canonical map $R\to R^{\mathrm{sh}}$ is faithfully flat.
